[CGMZ] Game Over
By: Casper Gaming
Last Update: May 17, 2026
Latest Version: 1.4.0
​
Provides the option to change the Game Over scene image/music based on a variable, and also allows you to add a command window to the Game Over scene which the player can use to quickly get back into the game.

Add a command window to load a save from the game over screen

posts.author: Skwis
posts.body:
Hi I'd like to let you know of a bug I found with this plugin.
When you get the game over screen and the command window pops up, selecting continue>autosave will bring you back to your last autosave point but it won't autoplay the bgm of the map.
In your demo there's a 5 second delay before the bgm begins autoplaying, however in my game it never begins playing at all.
I've temporarily fixed this by turning off the command window parameter in the plugin settings. So now game over screens will take me back to the title screen, and selecting continue from the default title menu's command window will bring me back to the last autosave point with the bgm autoplaying.
Hope this bug in the command window will get fixed. Otherwise I love this plugin so much and appreciate all that you do for the community

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
@Skwis
thanks for pointing this out, it seems to have something to do with ME sounds not being stopped so the bgm was unable to start. Should be fixed in latest update.
Version 1.0.1:
- Fixed bug with map bgm/bgs not autoplaying if using me sound type

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
@daveycadaver
Hi, to set a variable, you will want to create an event somewhere on the map and then in the event commands list, select the Control Variable event command. Then select the variable id you set up in the plugin parameters and set it to the number you want.
So for example if in the plugin parameters you set the game over image variable to variable id 1:
Then in your event you would add a control variables event command to set that variable to the number you want:
If you set it to 1, it will show the first image in your Images parameter in the plugin:
If you had set it to 2, it would show the second image in the list, and so on.

posts.author: CasperGaming

Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.1.0!
This update adds similar control over the game over command window that my other command window plugins do. You can now create your own custom commands, including show and enable conditions. Your commands can be customized with a background image as well as a separately aligned icon. Command text now supports text codes.
Version 1.1.0
Added option to create custom commands
Added additional command customization
Commands support text codes

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.2.0!
This version adds videos to your game over screen. Videos function similarly to how you set up music and image changes throughout your game. Video will loop and be displayed behind the Game Over image so you can display static Game Over text over the top of the video still. Videos are played on mute so the sound still comes from your music you have set up. See below gif for how it can look:
Integrations with [CGMZ] Window Settings and [CGMZ] Window Backgrounds were also added. These allow you to change the command window's tone, windowskin, and more. You can also add a background image to the window, including an animated scrolling parallax image.
Version 1.2.0
Added video to game over screen
Added [CGMZ] Window Settings integration
Added [CGMZ] Window Backgrounds integration

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.3.0!
This version adds pictures you can show that will function as commands. This can help get your game away from the standard RPG Maker look with the command window. Pictures can have an inactive and active state, which is applied when that picture is hovered or selected. Pictures work with all control types, including touch, keyboard, and gamepad. See below gif for how it can look:
To use pictures in place of your command window, set the Number of Commands parameter to 0 to hide the command window.
Version 1.3.0
Added pictures that can take the place of the command window

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.4.0!
This version adds a tip window to your game over screen, so you can provide the player with helpful hints or tips if they keep losing. A random tip will be chosen from the list of possible tips, and they do support text codes. Tips support switches as a condition. If set, the switch must be ON before the tip is eligible to appear.
